East Delta is the farm belt and eastern Ladner fringe of the City of Delta, and the City publishes no boundary for the name.
The urban edge was formerly covered by the East Ladner Area Plan; the current OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), folded the former area plans into a single Land Use Plan.
Fraser Health describes this area plainly as the farmlands of East Delta, noting the Good Samaritan Delta View Care Centre is located there
Ladner's village sub-areas (Hawthorne, Holly, Neilsen Grove, Port Guichon) are west; North Delta is across the farm belt to the north-east; Tsawwassen is south-west
The stock is farm houses on agricultural land, with one farm house per lot under the A1 Agriculture zone of Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600
On the urban East Ladner edge, housing takes the Ladner RS and RD zones, and one townhome project is recorded on a developer source only: Skye at Holly Park, 4760 60B Street
The one large institution in the farmland is the Good Samaritan Delta View Care Centre, a long-term care home at 9321 Burns Drive, Delta, V4K 3N3

blocks.text: East Delta: rules that affect buyers

items.t: In the A1 zone, subdivision is permitted only where it complies with the OCP and has been approved under the Agricultural Land Commission Act if applicable, and the minimum lot size that may be created by subdivision is 8 hectares, with a home site severance exception under Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) policy
The A2 zone also sets an 8-hectare minimum for a lot created by subdivision, and the A3 zone does not permit subdivision

ALC housing rules cap an ALR parcel at one principal residence of at most 500 m² built without an ALC application, a secondary suite only inside the principal residence, and one additional detached residence of up to 90 m² on parcels of 40 hectares or less or 186 m² on larger parcels — anything beyond that needs ALC approval

Delta's A1 zone mirrors those limits: a farm house maximum of 500 m², a farm home plate maximum of 3,600 m², one secondary suite inside the farm house, and one accessory farm dwelling unit within the same 90 m² / 186 m² size limits
Farm land here is designated "Agriculture (A)" in the OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), whose Agriculture policies (OCP s. 2.6) apply to Delta's agricultural land

blocks.text: East Delta: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Delta's agricultural ditches work two ways: in the farm area the ditches and pump stations run in drainage mode in winter and irrigation mode in summer, when ditch water is used to irrigate crops, with City control gates regulating levels
A farm property's well is searched in the provincial Groundwater Wells and Aquifers (GWELLS) registry, and wells built before the Water Sustainability Act came into force may not appear in it

A building with indoor plumbing that is not connected to a community sewer must use an onsite sewage system complying with the provincial Sewerage System Regulation, designed and installed by an Authorized Person, per Fraser Health
The Boundary Bay Dyke Trail runs from 17A Avenue to Mud Bay in Boundary Bay Regional Park (Metro Vancouver), along the south side of the Delta farm area
Ladner Pioneer Library, 4683 51 Street, is the library serving this farm area

blocks.text: East Delta: development and new projects

items.t: The confirmed infrastructure project touching this area is dike work: the City of Delta is raising sections of the Boundary Bay dike between 72 Street and 88 Street with provincial grant funding

The farm-area difference is how water and sewer are billed and supplied: Delta bills water and sewer either on the annual flat rate utility bill or in separate quarterly metered bills, and unserviced farm parcels rely on wells and onsite sewage instead

No bus route serving the interior farm roads of East Delta was confirmed; the confirmed services run on the area's edges. TransLink route 601 runs via Ladner Exchange, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99 to Bridgeport Station
Route 620 (Tsawwassen Ferry – Bridgeport Station) runs via Ladner Exchange, Highway 17A and Highway 17

blocks.text: East Delta: risks and due diligence

items.t: Start with ALR status and the housing caps: reserve status controls the 500 m² principal-residence cap and the additional-residence limits, and it is checked parcel by parcel on the ALC maps

Check flood protection requirements and streamside rules with the City before development near a regulated water body — Delta's low farm land is diked, and the City lists flood protection among its development checks
Diligence the water and septic: search the well in GWELLS (older wells may be missing) and ask for the Authorized Person's sewerage filings for any onsite system
Check the farm home plate, not just the house: the A1 maximum is 3,600 m² for the residential footprint, which caps where the farm house and accessory buildings can sit

faq.a: No. The City of Delta plans the city as Ladner, Tsawwassen and North Delta, and "East Delta" is a Paragon sub-area name for the rural farm area east of Ladner, covered by the municipal-wide OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024); the urban part was formerly under the East Ladner Area Plan, which Bylaw No. 8400 folded into its single Land Use Plan.
faq.q: Is East Delta an official City of Delta neighbourhood?

faq.a: Under Agricultural Land Commission rules, an ALR parcel may have one principal residence plus, in some cases, one additional detached residence up to 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on larger parcels; Delta zoning also allows one accessory farm dwelling unit in the A1 zone within those size limits.
faq.q: Can a farm parcel in East Delta have a second dwelling?

faq.a: Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, s. 10.10.8, sets the minimum lot size that may be created by subdivision in the A1 zone at 8 ha, subject to OCP compliance and Agricultural Land Commission Act approval where applicable.
faq.q: What is the smallest new farm lot that can be created in the A1 zone?

faq.a: Catchments are address-based in School District 37 (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12, no middle tier) and no sample-address result is published for this sub-area — check the exact address in the SD37 School Locator.

Delta's low farm land is protected by dykes, and the City lists flood protection requirements among the checks that apply to development; the City is raising sections of the Boundary Bay dike between 72 Street and 88 Street with provincial grant funding — confirm the requirement for a specific lot with the City.
